home.title: Welcome to the digital platform of the Al-Shuaibi Family in Al-Ahsa
home.subtitle: The official digital platform of the Al-Shuaibi family in Al-Ahsa — bringing family members together, preserving heritage, sharing achievements, organizing events, and strengthening community bonds through modern technology.

aboutSection.title: Everything the family needs in one place
aboutSection.body: The Al-Shuaibi family platform is a central digital hub where members can stay connected, take part in events, access family services, discover opportunities, and contribute to the growth of future generations.

about.title: About us
about.subtitle: The story of the Elsh3aby family and our shared vision.
about.body: Elsh3aby is a family community that brings relatives and friends together in one place to follow news, occasions, and shared memories. We aim to build a simple, secure platform that keeps everyone connected.
about.missionBody: Strengthen family communication, preserve heritage, and make it easier to share occasions and everyday moments.
